kol.detail: AI agents are approaching a point where they can use computers faster than expert humans, turning the user interface itself into a universal way for AI to interact with software. OpenAI’s Ari Weinstein and James Sun argue that computer use is now entering its scaling moment, as better models, faster execution, and stronger safety controls make agents practical for more consumer and enterprise work. kol.detail_zh: OpenAI 的 Ari Weinstein 和 James Sun 指出，AI 代理正逼近甚至超越专家级人类操作电脑的速度，将用户界面转变为 AI 与软件交互的通用接口。他们认为凭借更强模型、更快执行及安全控制，计算机使用正迎来「规模化时刻」。此类代理已在企业场景落地，能自主操作传统 ERP 系统、对账财务数据及处理采购流程。

kol_archive.take_zh: 黄仁勋称，英伟达与微软正共同重构面向个人智能体的 Windows，相关工作历时四年、投入数千人年工程资源；原帖未披露商业化指标。
kol_archive.detail: Awesome day, @satyanadella! Windows sparked a platform shift that created a new industry for NVIDIA. Then we invented programmable shading GPUs for DirectX, which led to CUDA. Then we partnered to bring GPU supercomputers to Azure, which helped OpenAI train GPT. That collaboration inspired us to reinvent Windows for the age of personal agents. 4 years. Thousands of engineering years between us. So proud of what we built together.
kol_archive.detail_zh: 黄仁勋回顾了英伟达与微软从 Windows、DirectX 到 CUDA、Azure GPU 超算的合作，并提到 Azure 算力曾帮助 OpenAI 训练 GPT。 他表示，这些合作启发双方为个人智能体时代重新构想 Windows，相关工作历时四年、投入数千人年工程资源。原帖没有披露具体产品规格、收费方式、上线范围或用户规模。

kol_archive.take: agent 价值正在从一次性生成转向长期工作流；状态管理、成本归因、工具调用和反馈闭环会决定 token 消耗与产品粘性。
kol_archive.take_en: Agent value is moving from one-shot generation to durable workflows; state, cost attribution, tool use and feedback loops drive token usage and stickiness.
kol_archive.take_zh: Guillermo Rauch 指出，程序加固与性能优化几乎可以无限进行，但会消耗时间、注意力和机会成本。即使 Token 充裕，团队仍需为智能体设定停止条件和取舍标准。
kol_archive.detail: One thing the engineering community will (re)discover is that every program can be ① hardened (edge cases squashed, inputs tightened, errors handled) and ② optimized (profiled, benchmarked, rewritten) basically ad infinitum. There are real costs in every direction: time, attention, opportunity. You can literally explore input spaces that will never be hit or optimize performance of something that will never be used ("you have no users".) Even in an infinite token world, you need to know when to stop and what tradeoffs to accept. Agents will happily drill no matter what.
kol_archive.detail_zh: Guillermo Rauch 指出，程序可以不断消除边界问题、收紧输入和完善错误处理，也可以通过性能分析、基准测试和重写持续优化。技术上仍能改进，并不意味着继续投入就值得。 团队可能优化无人使用的功能，或探索生产环境永远不会遇到的输入。即使假设 Token 无限，仍须决定何时停止、接受哪些取舍；智能体本身可能持续深入而不会主动判断商业价值。

kol_archive.take: agent 价值正在从一次性生成转向长期工作流；状态管理、成本归因、工具调用和反馈闭环会决定 token 消耗与产品粘性。
kol_archive.take_en: Agent value is moving from one-shot generation to durable workflows; state, cost attribution, tool use and feedback loops drive token usage and stickiness.
kol_archive.take_zh: Amjad Masad 表示，桌面 AI 应用存在供应链攻击与智能体误操作风险。其团队正与微软合作打造重视安全和可靠性的桌面体验，并成为英伟达 OpenShell 的早期采用者。
kol_archive.detail: Desktop AI apps are great but expose users to supply-chain attacks and catastrophic mistakes by agents. We’re building a powerful desktop experience with focus on security & reliability. Excited to partner with @Microsoft on this and be an early adopter of @nvidia’s OpenShell.
kol_archive.detail_zh: Amjad Masad 指出，桌面 AI 应用虽然能力强，但可能让用户面临供应链攻击，以及智能体误操作造成的严重后果。 他表示，团队正在构建强调安全与可靠性的桌面体验，与微软合作，并成为英伟达 OpenShell 的早期采用者。原帖未披露具体安全机制、产品发布时间、定价或使用规模。

kol_archive.take: 模型商业化要看真实路由和 $ spend 份额，而不是只看 benchmark；渠道份额能更早暴露谁在生产流量里变现。
kol_archive.take_en: Model monetization is better tracked through real routing and $ spend share than benchmarks; channel share reveals who is monetizing production traffic.
kol_archive.take_zh: Vercel AI Gateway 推出 Beta 功能：当主模型置信度低于设定阈值时，可让备用模型重新处理不确定决策。原帖尚未提供准确率改善或额外调用成本的数据。
kol_archive.detail: Your agents can now escalate uncertain decisions to a fallback model. AI Gateway reruns the decision on a fallback model when the primary model's confidence drops below your threshold. Available in beta.
kol_archive.detail_zh: Vercel AI Gateway 宣布一项 Beta 功能：当主模型置信度低于用户设定的阈值时，将不确定决策交由备用模型重新执行。 这一机制把是否追加模型调用与置信度阈值联系起来。原帖未说明置信度如何计算，也未披露适用模型范围、准确率提升、延迟或额外成本。

kol_archive.detail: .@OpenRouter co-founder Alex Atallah, in his first podcast since Stripe acquired the company, joins @Replit co-founder Amjad Masad and a16z's Erik Torenberg on why the future of AI is independence and specialization. In this conversation, Alex walks through how the Stripe deal unfolded, why he wasn't originally looking to sell, and why "payments and inference are going to blend together." Pre-OpenRouter, the typical AI workflow had one model provider to choose from, and little pressure on that provider to lower prices. Now enterprises are diversifying across labs and open-weight models, and ev...
kol_archive.detail_zh: OpenRouter联合创始人Alex Atallah在被Stripe收购后首度公开对话，与Replit创始人Amjad Masad及a16z的Erik Torenberg探讨AI独立性与专业化趋势。他透露收购并非主动寻求，并预判“支付与推理将深度融合”。他指出OpenRouter打破了以往企业依赖单一模型供应商且无议价权的局面，推动企业转向跨实验室及开源模型的多元化部署。

kol_archive.detail: We’ve confirmed a KVM 0day through our Vercel Sandbox bounty program. Affecting the industry’s gold standard solution for Linux virtualization. 2026 is wild! Thankful to Paulos and other researchers helping us make the most secure sandbox for agents. Full writeup coming.
kol_archive.detail_zh: Vercel 通过 Sandbox 赏金计划确认发现 KVM 零日漏洞，波及 Linux 虚拟化领域的行业标准方案。研究员 Paulos 等人协助修复，旨在构建最安全的 Agent 沙箱，完整技术报告即将发布。

kol_archive.take_zh: 卡帕西提出让大模型采用航空维护受控语言ASD-STE100进行解释，利用其严格写作约束显著提升输出可读性，并建议可放宽至“80%合规”平衡实用性。
kol_archive.detail: We'll be spending a lot more time trying to understand the outputs of language models. A few thoughts, tips & tricks: Writing. Something I've had success with: Ask your LLM to explain something in ASD-STE100, it's a controlled language specification originally developed for aerospace maintenance documentation. LLMs well-versed in this language and it comes with heavy constraints on clean writing style that I often find a lot more readable. Sometimes I've tried to soften it a bit e.g. ask for "80% of the way to ASD-STE100" because the spec is quite stringent. But even better: Diagrams / images....
kol_archive.detail_zh: 安德烈·卡帕西指出，为更好理解语言模型的输出，可以让模型使用 ASD‑STE100 这套航空维护文档的受控语言进行解释，因其严格的写作约束往往产生更易读

kol_archive.take_en: AI interfaces increasingly serve both humans and agents; composable design systems and structured UI lower the cost of generating, editing and validating frontends.
kol_archive.take_zh: Boris Cherny 在 X 上宣布，Claude Code 现已支持通过插件进行自定义模组。用户可用几行 TypeScript 编写模组，或让 Claude 自行生成，模组以插件形式打包，在命令行或桌面应用中通过 /plugin 安装。如此一来，可以自由改变行为、定制界面或加入新功能。

kol_archive.detail: Fable is probably ~2-2.5T parameters, not 10T. Kimi K3 is 2.8T params, trained on maybe 20–30k Blackwell-equivalents. It lands within spitting distance of Fable 5 in terms of capabilities (5, not 5.1). Anthropic has far more compute than Moonshot, better rl environments, better architecture and better optimizers and all of that adds to capability per parameter. So if Fable is only slightly ahead of K3 with this in mind, it's almost certainly a smaller model. GPT-5.5 and 5.6 are smaller still (I'll say more on that later)
kol_archive.detail_zh: Fable 的参数规模约为 2‑2.5 万亿，远低于之前猜测的 10 万亿，而 Kimi K3 为 2.8 万亿参数，使用约 2‑3 万块 Blackwell 等效算力进行训练。在能力上 Kimi K3 接近 Fable 5（非 5.1），但 Anthropic 拥有更多算力、更强的 RL 环境、更好的架构与优化器，使其每参数能力更高。由此可推断，若 Fable 仅略胜于 K3，则其实际规模可能更小；此外，GPT‑5.5 与 GPT‑5.6 预计将是更小的模型。

kol_archive.detail: We’re sharing a solution to the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem, one of the deepest problems at the frontier of mathematics. The proof was produced by a group of agents, using an OpenAI next-generation model significantly more capable than GPT-6 Astra. The problem concerns whether the description of smooth three-dimensional fluid motion modeled by the Navier-Stokes equations can break down. It has remained unresolved for roughly 90 years.
kol_archive.detail_zh: Sam Altman 在 X 平台宣布，他们正在公开 Navier‑Stokes 千禧年奖问题的一个解答。该证明由一组智能体完成，使用的 OpenAI 下一代模型能力远超 GPT‑6 Astra。该问题探讨光滑三维流体运动在 Navier‑Stokes 方程下是否可能失解，悬而未决约 90 年。

kol_archive.detail: I am pleased to see that OpenAI’s new model is roughly on par with Gemini Flash and Opus 4.8 on prompt injection risk. Nice work! Evaluating and naming other labs turns out to be a great way to encourage them to train more aligned models. We will continue to do this until other labs pay more attention to safety. This is good for everyone and there is a lot of room left to go! We solved prompt injection in practice for Claude models about two months ago. But prompt injection is a significant security risk no matter what model you use, and it is important that the industry similarly spends more...
kol_archive.detail_zh: Boris Cherny 表示，OpenAI 最新模型在提示注入风险方面与 Gemini Flash 和 Opus 4.8 大致持平。他指出，通过评估和命名其他实验室能够促使其训练更对齐的模型，而他们已在约两个月前在 Claude 模型上实际解决了提示注入问题。但提示注入仍是所有模型的重要安全风险，行业需要投入更多资源以进一步改善。

Some pretty unique wins too. e.g: Next.js dev pages could expose debugging tools directly to agents in the specific tab they’re testing, with page-specific context, instead of sifting through server logs. No separate MCP server to find and configure because the page directly exposes its own 'agent tools'. e.g: in this world 𝚏𝚡 + 𝚊𝚐𝚎𝚗𝚝-𝚋𝚛𝚘𝚠𝚜𝚎𝚛 is a complete web dev stack with zero loss in debuggin...

kol_archive.take_zh: Guillermo Rauch 指出企业将编程 Token 视同无限制 AWS 密钥，允许从 3.8 美元/月到 4 万美元/月实例随意调用，缺乏治理。AI Gateway 新增按密钥及按用户预算控制，防止资源滥用。
kol_archive.detail: Coding tokens are basically infrastructure. Yet, the way companies have approached them amounts to: "Hey all, here's an AWS key. It can spin up anything from a 𝚝𝟹.𝚗𝚊𝚗𝚘 (＄𝟹.𝟾𝟶/𝚖𝚘) to an 𝚙𝟻.𝟺𝟾𝚡𝚕𝚊𝚛𝚐𝚎 (＄𝟺𝟶𝚔/𝚖𝚘). Go wild" And obviously the reason companies don't do this for their core infra is that you need to govern, optimize, and observe usage and costs. The intern might decide to host a static website in that 192 vCPU machine, and you won't be very happy about the bill. AI Gateway fixes this for all your tokens, with per-key, and now per-user budgets.
kol_archive.detail_zh: Guillermo Rauch 指出，编程 Token 实为基础设施，但企业管理却如发放无限制 AWS 密钥，允许从低成本到月费 4 万美元实例随意调用，严重缺乏治理与成本观测。他强调 AI Gateway 解决此痛点，新增按密钥及按用户预算控制，防止资源滥用如用昂贵实例托管静态网站。
